title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 13: Saul's unlawful burnt offering at Gilgal and Israel without swords against the Philistines.

questions.text: How old was Saul when he became king?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 13:1 says Saul was thirty years old when he became king.

questions.text: Where was the garrison of the Philistines that Jonathan struck?
questions.explanation: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba.

questions.text: Where did the people of Israel hide when they saw they were in trouble?
questions.explanation: The people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.

answers.text: In the cities of the Philistines
In caves, thickets, rocks, tombs and pits
In the house of Yahweh at Shiloh
In the land of Egypt and in Moab

questions.text: How long did Saul wait at Gilgal according to the time set by Samuel?
questions.explanation: He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel, but Samuel didn't come.

questions.text: What did Saul do when Samuel did not come and the people were scattering?
questions.explanation: Saul said, "Bring the burnt offering to me here," and he offered the burnt offering.

answers.text: He went to look for Samuel
He attacked the Philistines at once

questions.text: What did Samuel say to Saul about what he had done?
questions.explanation: Samuel said, "You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of Yahweh your God."

questions.text: What kind of man did Samuel say Yahweh had sought for himself?
questions.explanation: Samuel said, "Yahweh has sought for himself a man after his own heart."

answers.text: A man from the tribe of Levi
A man after his own heart

questions.text: About how many men were with Saul when he counted the people?
questions.explanation: Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.

questions.text: Why was there no blacksmith in all the land of Israel?
questions.explanation: The Philistines said, "Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears."

answers.text: So the Hebrews could not make swords or spears
Because the blacksmiths had all died in battle
Because Saul had forbidden all work with iron
Because there was no iron anywhere in the land

questions.text: On the day of battle, who among Saul's people had a sword and spear?
questions.explanation: Neither sword nor spear was found with the people, but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.
